<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 700" width="600" height="700" style="background:#0A0B10; font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="glow" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#345CFF" stop-opacity="0.25" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0A0B10" stop-opacity="1" />
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Background Canvas -->
  <rect width="600" height="700" fill="#0A0B10" />
  <rect x="24" y="24" width="552" height="652" rx="16" fill="url(#glow)" stroke="#171A22" stroke-width="2" />

  <!-- Brand Mark Header -->
  <text x="56" y="70" fill="#F4F2EB" font-size="12" font-weight="800" letter-spacing="2">BOARDED CLIMBING JOURNAL</text>
  <text x="544" y="70" fill="#32D583" font-size="12" font-weight="700" text-anchor="end" letter-spacing="1">VERIFIED SEND</text>

  <line x1="56" y1="90" x2="544" y2="90" stroke="rgba(244, 242, 235, 0.12)" stroke-width="1" />

  <!-- Grade Display (Serif) -->
  <text x="56" y="150" fill="#345CFF" font-family="Georgia,serif" font-size="52" font-weight="bold" font-style="italic">
    5.12a
  </text>

  <!-- Route Title -->
  <text x="56" y="195" fill="#F4F2EB" font-family="Georgia,serif" font-size="28" font-weight="bold" font-style="italic">
    Redpoint Ridge
  </text>

  <!-- Crag & Attributes -->
  <text x="56" y="225" fill="#9ca3af" font-size="14">
    Stonegate · Sport · 27 m · Limestone
  </text>

  <!-- Status Shelf -->
  <rect x="56" y="255" width="488" height="68" rx="8" fill="#171A22" stroke="rgba(244,242,235,0.08)" />
  <text x="76" y="285" fill="#9ca3af" font-size="11" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="1">CLIMBER</text>
  <text x="76" y="307" fill="#F4F2EB" font-size="14" font-weight="600">Alex R.</text>
  <text x="210" y="285" fill="#9ca3af" font-size="11" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="1">ATTEMPTS</text>
  <text x="210" y="307" fill="#F4F2EB" font-size="14" font-weight="600">2 tries</text>
  <text x="340" y="285" fill="#9ca3af" font-size="11" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="1">DATE</text>
  <text x="340" y="307" fill="#F4F2EB" font-size="14" font-weight="600">2026-09-06</text>
  <text x="470" y="285" fill="#32D583" font-size="11" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="1">OUTCOME</text>
  <text x="470" y="307" fill="#32D583" font-size="14" font-weight="700">SENT</text>

  <!-- Caption & Beta Notes -->
  <rect x="56" y="345" width="488" height="240" rx="8" fill="#12141C" stroke="rgba(244,242,235,0.06)" />
  <text x="80" y="380" fill="#F4F2EB" font-size="13" font-weight="700">CAPTION & NOTES</text>
  <text x="80" y="412" fill="#9ca3af" font-size="12">Conditions: Dry & cool <18°C> 🧗</text>


  <!-- Footer Seal -->
  <text x="300" y="640" fill="#6b7280" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">
    Verified Local Record · Boarded Editorial Journal
  </text>
</svg>
